description: Rank the most compressible (cliched) phrases in a chapter — Finds the phrases in a passage that compress most against a reference corpus of generic prose, so a writer can target the low-entropy spans instead of guessing. For each sentence (default) or sliding n-gram, computes the marginal compressed-byte contribution per character with zlib level 9 and a built-in reference corpus of common narrative clichés; the lowest-scoring spans are the most predictabl

mode.description: sentence (default) scores at sentence boundaries; ngram scores every sliding window of ngramSize words.

ngramSize.description: Words per window when mode is ngram (default 5).

reference.description: Optional reference corpus to prepend before compression. When absent, the built-in 50 KB generic-prose corpus is used unless useBuiltInReference is false.

text.description: The chapter or passage to score.

topN.description: How many lowest-score spans to return (default 10).

useBuiltInReference.description: Pass false to score with no reference corpus (local redundancy only). Default true.

name: compressibility-rank
